instruction:
Light industrial workshop from scratch. In Archicad, create a new one-storey light industrial workshop using real BIM elements for spaces, walls, slab, and multiple roof elements. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

The IFC must contain exactly one IfcBuildingStorey, exactly six IfcSpace zones on that storey, at least twenty wall elements, at least one slab element, at least four roof elements, and unique IFC GlobalId values for exported root objects. Create W01 BAY-1 30.0 m2, W02 BAY-2 30.0 m2, W03 OFFICE 9.0 m2, W04 STORE 9.0 m2, W05 WC 4.0 m2, and W06 LOADING 16.0 m2.

Store each zone number as Reference or LongName where possible. Each listed area must be within +/-0.10 m2, the two bay zones together must be between 59.0 and 61.0 m2, and the total zone area must be between 97.0 and 99.0 m2. The evaluator should be able to recognize equivalent wall and roof export styles, so do not rely on fixed GUIDs or object names beyond the required zone labels.
